dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: Nice. I'll call it a day and report back to my aunt.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: My aunt runs a hotel. There's only one hotel in Caravan Ribat, so it should be easy to find.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: I used to live in the city with my parents, but I really didn't have a thing for school, and it was annoying to be pushed by them every day. So I came here to work with my aunt.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: I learned a lot with her, and am getting more skilled at bargaining with vendors than ever.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: This is something you'll never learn from the Akasha Terminal.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you heading back?

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: Hmm, not now. I just passed a camp of the Eremites, and he was not there. Maybe he went to the hotel looking for me for a drink.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: To be honest, most Sumeru people like to drink, but I'm not used to alcohol. I would feel dizzy after just half a glass.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: But it'd be a lack of decorum to refuse an Eremite. He often comes to invite me for a drink, and I should care about his feelings.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: I'll just stay out of his sight for now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your aunt, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: Yes, she runs a hotel. There's only one in Caravan Ribat, so it should be pretty easy to find.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: I used to live in the city with my parents, but I really didn't have a thing for school, and it was annoying to be pushed by them every day. So I came here to work with my aunt.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: I learned a lot with her and I'm getting more skilled at bargaining with vendors than ever.

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: Even if the Akasha Terminals were still around, that wasn't something they could've taught you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: Unbelievable. I actually beat a veteran? Lady luck is shining on me!

dialogues.speaker: Maziar
dialogues.text: As I thought, beating a veteran is not easy...
